evals.name: Junior-Friendly GitHub Issue Creation & Branch Initialization
evals.prompt: Create a structured GitHub Issue and checkout a normalized feature branch for implementing EMI amortization calculations.
evals.expected_output: Creates issue with Overview, Context, and Acceptance Criteria, then checks out feat/<id>-emi-amortization-schedule off latest main.
assertions: Generates issue title using Conventional Commit syntax
Includes clear acceptance criteria checklist in issue body
Checks out normalized feature branch matching feat/<id>-<slug>
Pulls latest commits from main before branching

evals.name: Pull Request Generation with Mandatory Auto-Closing Syntax
evals.prompt: Draft a pull request description for branch feat/14-emi-amortization linking issue #14.
evals.expected_output: Drafts PR body with technical overview, quality checklist, and explicit Closes #14 auto-closing directive.
assertions: Includes Closes #14 or Fixes #14 in PR body
Summarizes code modifications and test coverage results
Targets default branch main as PR base
Avoids non-closing ambiguous phrases like Related to #14

evals.name: Post-Merge Branch Pruning & Main Sync
evals.prompt: Clean up local and remote git branches after Pull Request #14 is merged into main.
evals.expected_output: Checks out main, pulls merged changes, safely deletes local feat/14-emi-amortization, and deletes remote origin branch.
assertions: Switches local branch back to main
Pulls latest remote commits from origin main
Deletes local merged feature branch via git branch -d
Deletes remote origin branch via git push origin --delete
